notes.title: Demo Release & Participation in Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101993/72a6fd20f1d34da83b19776cadbc27fb30ecaa6d.jpg
Hello.

Our game 5omeday has released a demo version to coincide with the Steam Next Fest starting on February 25th.

5omeday is a multi-ending visual novel where you can execute a death-row girl at any time by pressing a button.
The story revolves around monitoring a girl, sentenced for setting an entire village ablaze, over the course of five days until her execution.

In the room, there is an execution button.
If the girl acts suspiciously or seems like she may cause harm, you can choose to execute her immediately.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101993/5d049d14982d5baa616349cabe2c9d1b1f227610.jpg

The Steam version supports English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese in addition to Japanese,
so we hope players from various regions can enjoy the game.

We are currently working toward the full release on Steam and Nintendo Switch,
so please consider adding it to your wishlist in the meantime.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3030980

Please look forward to more updates about the game.
